Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "could you draft a watering rota for the north greenhouse for the week of May 12–18? We’re trying to make sure the daily jobs are covered, not change how much the plants get. There are three beds: A has seedlings and needs 3 litres every morning; B has tomatoes and needs 5 litres every morning; C has herbs and needs 2 litres each evening. Those amounts and times are already set.

Mara can work Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Luis can work Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday. Priya can work Sunday. Please have one person handle all three beds on each day, and don’t assign anyone on a day they aren’t available. It’s fine for the same person to cover their listed days; there aren’t any other staffing rules to factor in. Make sure every bed is covered on all seven days. I need something the volunteers can follow at a glance, rather than a paragraph explaining the plan. Use a numbered checklist, with one item for each bed on each day, and include the day, bed, assigned person, water amount, and morning or evening timing in every item. Please use only the details here to make the draft.", "output": "Create a draft watering rota for the north greenhouse for May 12–18. Cover all three beds every day, without changing their established watering amounts or times:

- Bed A (seedlings): 3 litres every morning
- Bed B (tomatoes): 5 litres every morning
- Bed C (herbs): 2 litres each evening

Assign one person to handle all three beds each day, using only these availabilities:

- Mara: Monday, Wednesday, Friday
- Luis: Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday
- Priya: Sunday

Use the information provided and do not assign anyone on a day they are unavailable. Present the rota as a numbered checklist, with one item for each bed on each day. Include the day, bed, assigned person, water amount, and morning or evening timing in every item. Keep it easy for volunteers to follow at a glance."}]
